output.review_comment: The boundary condition change from `<=` to `<` appears to be a bug. With `<`, a line of exactly `width` characters would be rejected and moved to the next line, wasting space. For example, with width=10, "hell world" (10 chars) would not fit, forcing unnecessary line breaks. This should be `<=` to allow lines to pack exactly to width. Additionally, no PR description was provided explaining these changes or confirming the tests pass. Please verify this change against the test suite and provide clarification on the intent of the `<` operator.
